item.text:
**8B.6 Research Note: Srettha Thavisin in 2024**

Overall: mixed, leaning negative. There are several real implementation steps, but the strongest recurring pattern is that flagship promises were only partially operationalized and some of the most visible delivery efforts remained fragile, delayed, or politically compromised.

**Positive evidence**
- [Thailand's cabinet approves 135 billion digital wallet handout](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-23: Cabinet approval turned Srettha’s flagship promise into a funded state program for 50 million people, which is concrete translation from slogan into implementation. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Thai ex-executive Pichai named finance minister, faces growth challenge](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thai-exexecutive-pichai-named-finance-minister-faces-growth-challenge-3401984) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-28: Srettha moved a technocratic adviser with Stock Exchange of Thailand and Bank of Thailand background into Finance and Deputy PM, a real staffing choice to carry out the economic program. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Thailand - Australia policy outreach / FTA improvement](https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/2078/iid/266801) - Public Relations Department, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-03-06: The government used formal policy channels to promote trade, investment, tourism, technology, innovation, and FTA improvement, which is observable bureaucratic execution rather than rhetoric alone. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Summary of Weekly Press Briefing 19 April 2024](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/weeklypressbriefing190424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-04-19: Thailand said the Prime Minister had instructed agencies to form a special committee to monitor the Myanmar situation, showing an explicit operational crisis-management mechanism. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`.
- [Thailand ratifies disappearance treaty / anti-torture law](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/icpped140524-2?page=5d5bd3da15e39c306002aaf9) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-05-16: The government translated rights rhetoric into legal machinery intended to constrain abuse, which is stronger evidence of implementation than mere declaratory intent. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`.
- [Victory: Same-sex marriage Thailand](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/victory-same-sex-marriage-thailand) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-06-18: Same-sex marriage passed under Srettha’s government, demonstrating that the legislative apparatus could still be mobilized to complete a concrete reform. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`.

**Negative evidence**
- [Thailand's flagship $14 billion handout scheme suffers early snags as millions rush to register](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html) - Reuters via Yahoo News, 2024-08-01: The digital-wallet rollout hit registration failures, delay, and sustained expert criticism, which is strong evidence that the flagship promise had not become a stable delivery system. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`.
- [Thai central bank holds key rate, defies government calls for cuts](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-10: Repeated government pressure on the Bank of Thailand shows an attempt to mobilize an independent institution for short-term growth relief, but also weak respect for technocratic autonomy. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Forty Thai senators seek PM's dismissal over cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/forty-thai-senators-seek-pms-dismissal-over-cabinet-appointment/2089532/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-05-17: The Pichit Chuenban appointment triggered a formal Senate challenge, showing that politically connected staffing undermined governing discipline and became a major liability. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Thai court says PM Srettha violated rules on ethics in cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-says-pm-srettha-violated-rules-on-ethics-in-cabinet-appointment/2222960/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-14: The Constitutional Court’s dismissal over the same appointment is the clearest negative evidence that a central cabinet choice was not cleanly separated from patronage politics. QIDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Thailand charges 2 journalists for reporting on anti-royal vandalism](https://cpj.org/2024/02/thailand-charges-2-journalists-for-reporting-on-anti-royal-vandalism/) - Committee to Protect Journalists, 2024-02-14: The arrest of journalists for reporting on sensitive graffiti shows coercive state reach, but not the kind of transparent implementation that would support a strong 8B.6 score. QIDs: `8B.6`, `7B.1`, `7B.2`.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a public cross-ministry implementation dashboard, cabinet delivery tracker, or ministry-by-ministry performance audit for Srettha’s 2024 government. The positive side is therefore based on discrete observable acts, not a comprehensive execution record.
